name: gaze
description: Local face detection + recognition + gaze direction. Spawns a Python server (InsightFace + Gazelle + MediaPipe) as a child process.

default_subscriptions.description: Gaze node control commands (toggle capture, switch model). Forwarded to the Python sidecar.

action.description: Capture lifecycle action to perform on the Python sidecar.

device.description: Camera device index (only used when action='start'). Defaults to 0.

fps.description: Target capture frame rate (only used when action='start'). Defaults to 6.

profile_id.description: Stable profile identifier of the face to rename.

name.description: New human-readable name for the profile.

default_subscriptions.description: Merge two face profile IDs into one.

keep.description: Profile ID to keep as the canonical identity.

drop.description: Profile ID to merge into 'keep' and then remove.
